scope.description: Whole webp application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Static/animated WebP encoding and decoding, alpha/colour, quality/compression controls, metadata and container operations.

coverage.rationale: Core static encode/decode families are covered, but animation, broad container/metadata and encoder controls are absent.

scope.description: Bounded lossless PNG/WebP round trip and opaque lossy encoding with numeric error/byte requirements.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Lossless preservation or explicit error/size goals express web-asset intent; quality choices and numeric rather than perceptual criteria remain user decisions.

limitations: Closed PNG/static simple WebP subsets; lossy is opaque only; no animation/metadata/colour management or perceptual quality guarantee.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
